As such, conditions in the water change and new fish will be entering our waters. As the ocean heats up, we will be welcoming some familiar faces to our neighborly waters. Continue reading to learn which species of fish the waters will be teeming with and may end up going home with you on a Captain Daddy fishing charter! blurb: Captain Daddy's offers fishing charters in Daytona Beach and surrounding areas including Port Orange, New Smyrna Beach, and Ormond Beach. They provide inshore fishing for smaller species and offshore fishing for larger species. Charters include all necessary equipment, licenses, bait, and tackle with a USCG licensed captain.
